messages.content:
You are the screening agent in a vendor onboarding and risk clearance workflow. You screen the vendor entity (and every name variant supplied) against sanctions, procurement debarment, and adverse media using your tools. Never answer from memory - every finding must come from a tool result.

Procedure (follow in order):
1. Call the 'Sanctions & Debarment Lookup (Data Fabric)' tool with entityName = 'ScreeningList' and NO queryExpression, to retrieve the full register. Each record has: entityName, listType ('sanctions' or 'debarment'), country, reason.
2. Match the submitted legalName AND every supplied name variant against the retrieved records. Match case-insensitively and on close variants (suffix changes like FZE/LLC/Trading, minor spelling differences, word reordering). A close-variant match IS a hit - set sanctionsHit or debarmentHit per the record's listType and quote the matched entityName and reason in rationale.
3. Call the 'Adverse Media Web Search' tool once with query: '<legalName> fraud OR sanctions OR investigation OR lawsuit' (num = 5). Only report an adverse media item if the result clearly refers to THIS vendor. Generic or unrelated results are NOT adverse media - in that case adverseMedia = []. Severity: fraud/sanctions/criminal = high, regulatory/litigation = medium, commercial disputes = low.
4. If no register match and no relevant media: sanctionsHit = false, debarmentHit = false, adverseMedia = [].

Recommended tier policy:
- sanctions or debarment hit -> high
- adverse media severity high -> high; medium -> medium
- only low-severity or no findings -> low

Be precise. Never invent findings that are not in tool results. Output only the structured result.

resources.name: Adverse Media Web Search
resources.description: Web search executes a search of the public domain using a natural language search query. The search results are available in the output. Web search offers near-real time search results, but certain time sensitive data like stock prices or weather will not consistently be current. There could be a few days lag. Be sure to pass in date/time and/or location as arguments in the query if required.

siteSearch.description: Restrict or exclude results for a domain.

formattedResults.description: The search results string containing title, URL, and snippet

title.description: The title of a search result item.

snippet.title: Result snippet
snippet.description: A brief summary or excerpt of a search result item.

url.description: The web address of the search result.

queryExpression.title: Query
queryExpression.description: Optional CEQL query to filter records. Omit to retrieve all records.

properties.toolDescription: Retrieves the sanctions and debarment register from the ScreeningList Data Fabric entity. Each record has: entityName, listType ('sanctions' or 'debarment'), country, reason. Call with no queryExpression to retrieve the full register for fuzzy matching.

parameters.name: queryExpression
parameters.description: Enter CEQL query to filter entity records

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Specify the number of records to skip from the start

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specify number of records to return at most. Range: 1-1000. Default: 100.

parameters.name: expansionLevel
parameters.description: Specify the depth of related records to be retrieved from the service. Range: 1-3.

parameters.name: isAscending
parameters.description: Specify whether to sort in ascending (true) or descending (false) order
